policy: Every required detector must distinguish a concrete important failure; identical parameter products are not a coverage obligation.

changes.failure: Rollback before commit, committed-but-unknown register or activation ACK, cancellation, lease expiry, and public-state fencing must never grant an extra effect.
changes.before: 28 complete histories per SQL backend: frontend x recovery x seven boundaries.
changes.after: Ten independent histories per backend, all seven boundaries and all four origins.
changes.rationale: Fault injection and post-registration refusal/activation checks are shared across origins inside each backend. Tool/Frontend claim/recovery select different native authentication paths, so three alternate-origin faults remain; tool_source_tests and tool_guards_tests retain all four source/authority paths. Existing fresh::faults, activation_fault and refusals assertions are unchanged. PostgreSQL Current fixtures already contain the migrated schema; migration tests retain Blank provisioning.
changes.validation: All selected histories passed at one and four slots; Memory/SQLite20 selected cases each, managed PostgreSQL10fault+4pendingfixtures each; all4ownedcontainers and fixture registries drained. Full combined schedule and budget qualification remain pending.

changes.failure: Forged completion metadata, wrong claim/inspection/fence, oversized receipt, or wrong typed outcome must prevent registration and business dispatch.
changes.before: Twelve corruption preparations for each of four origins on every backend.
changes.after: All twelve on Memory for every origin; forged receipt revision (0) and suspended/wrong typed outcome (8) on both SQL backends for every origin.
changes.rationale: Completed::new, Source::metadata, claim-token/run/root-join checks and metadata/inspection equality are shared Rust pending execution code, independent of Store backend. SQL retains authentic preparation/commit/inspection followed by zero-register and zero-business-effect assertions for both a forged receipt and an invalid outcome on each of four independently authenticated origins. All held-stage faults and committed-ACK replay histories remain unchanged.
changes.validation: The original helper bodies passed on all backends at1/4 slots before the independent-family split; the renamed detector entrypoints need qualification.

changes.failure: State must survive independent PerCall Agent runs; real host state imports must enforce entry, value and key bounds without applying refused writes.
changes.before: 212 full Agent turns merely increment one state key past1000; actual default entry/value/key overflow was not crossed.
changes.after: Two actual Agent runs plus real PerCall guest writes across the default64-entry and16KiB byte bounds, failed-write snapshots unchanged; a direct999→1000 counter transition and existing two-session concurrent state history remain.
changes.rationale: The counter guest only updates count; another model turn repeats the same transport/state path. Direct guest calls exercise actual host imports and state snapshots at their owning WASM layer. Limits/defaults/instance mode and production implementations are unchanged.

changes.failure: Pending item and byte budgets must reject overflow while retaining head preparation/admission capacity.
changes.before: The exact private Memory queue_bounds contract executes in both the native session binary and source-embedded facade adapter.
changes.after: Canonical Memory and both independently implemented SQL queue bounds remain; only this named duplicate registration is absent from the embedding adapter.
changes.rationale: The adapter source-embeds the same Memory queue implementation and shared limits; its Store implementation still compiles. Its own fenced public and adapter-specific negative histories remain. No test-prefix filtering or generic adapter suite removal is used.

changes.failure: Completion/inspection/main must share the actual task; held ACK cancellation cannot dispatch; committed replay cannot repeat effects; blocked cleanup must retain ownership until actual release.
changes.before: Each of four origins bundles success, held-stage faults, malformed ACK/replay and blocked cleanup into one sequential Store history.
changes.after: Each origin has independently scheduled success/replay, held-ACK, malformed/replay and cleanup tests, each with fresh Store/clock. Current PostgreSQL clones reuse the already migrated template.
changes.rationale: The helpers preserve their assertions and internal task/join order. Separate families share no IDs, receipts, tasks or database state. Migration is not asserted in these wrappers; dedicated migration cases retain real migration calls.

required_behaviors.required_layer: Real SQLite/PostgreSQL and one public cold-reconciliation journey per backend
Actual OS processes for admission/queue/distinct tool and approval paths
Real SQL concurrency and one public controller lifecycle
Sentinel/effect checks and captured transport/log wiring
Real component bound plus short executable wiring per CLI
